description:
Comprehensive hardware diagnostic and testing suite for PC & Laptop.

Long AT Test is a standalone hardware testing and diagnostic tool for Windows computers and laptops. Includes testing for Keyboard (with low-level hook & press count), Battery health, LCD dead pixels, Stereo speakers, Microphone recorder, Camera/Webcam, accurate Hardware Specs (CPU, 12GB+ GPU VRAM, RAM, Disks), and Driver lookup by Serial number.
